meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能执行“添加 Linear 渠道”的全部配置。配好后,它会监听你指定的 Linear 团队,自动回复每个 issue 下的每条评论;每个 issue 的评论串是一个独立会话,无需 @ 提及。
howto.when: 当你说“把 Linear 接进来”“添加 Linear 集成”等,想给 NanoClaw 加上 Linear 渠道时触发。配置完成后,该团队 issue 下的新评论也会自动触发 agent 回复。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 接到 NanoClaw。
say.note: 会启动接入流程,向你询问凭据。

say.text: 配置 Linear 时用个人 API 密钥。
say.note: 之后 agent 以你的身份发评论,你自己的评论会被忽略。

say.text: 让 agent 自动回复 ENG 团队 issue 的所有评论。
say.note: 会先确认 agent 文件夹和发送策略,再完成接线。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can wire Linear into NanoClaw when asked. After it's set up, it watches the chosen team and auto-replies to every issue comment; each issue thread is a separate conversation, no @-mention needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect Linear to NanoClaw (e.g. 'add Linear' or 'connect Linear'). After setup, every new comment on the team's issues also triggers an automatic reply.

say_en.note: Claude will run setup and ask for credentials.

say_en.text: Set up Linear using a personal API key.
say_en.note: The agent will post as you; your own comments are ignored.

say_en.text: Auto-reply to all comments on ENG team issues.
say_en.note: It asks for agent folder and sender policy, then wires it.
